title: Say it another way
hint: Think together. Take turns to say it another way — the others agree or not. Then tap the card to check.
cards: ((Everyone at work)) talks about it all the time. It's getting a bit much.
Everyone at work keeps going on about it.
I stopped watching after the third episode.
I gave up after episode three.
It was slow at first, but from episode four it's much better.
It really picks up in episode four.
People say it's brilliant, but I don't think so.
It's not as good as everyone says.
I've watched a few short clips, not the whole thing.
I've only seen bits of it.
((Some of the jokes)) feel wrong today.
Some of the jokes haven't aged well.
It reminds me of when I was young.
It takes me back.
Don't waste your time on it.
Honestly? I wouldn't bother.
Watch an episode or two and see if you like it.
Give it a try.
OK, the music is good. I admit that.
The music's good, I'll give it that.

items: Everyone's talking about it. – все говорят ('s = is)
Everyone keeps going on about it. – твердят (надоело)
I've only seen bits of it. – видела отрывки
I gave up after episode 3. – бросила после
I couldn't get into it. – не втянулась
It really picks up in episode 4. – потом лучше
It's not as good as everyone says.
All the hype put me off. – оттолкнул
The acting's great, I'll give it that.
Well, it is a crime drama! – ну это же детектив
It takes me back. – как в детстве
The jokes haven't aged well. – устарели
I see it in a different light now.
Is it any good? – стоит смотреть?
I wouldn't bother. – не трать время (прямо)

speaking: Name two films or series everyone keeps going on about right now. Have you seen them — or only bits of them? Agree which one you'd tell a friend to give a try.
Which is the worst: a slow start, a disappointing ending, or jokes that haven't aged well? Put them in order and give a reason for each.
Think of a series you gave up on — or a popular one lots of people give up on. Give two reasons why it's hard to get into. Is it worth a second try?
Name one series that really picks up after a slow start and one that's not as good as everyone says — and say why. Haven't seen them? Say what you've heard.
An old film or cartoon that takes you back: name one thing that still works and one thing that hasn't aged well.
Name two films or series with a lot of hype. Agree which one is really good and which one is not as good as everyone says. Haven't seen one? Say if all the hype put you off.
